title: Provenance record, version 1
description: Where a file sent by Progressive Web Office comes from (SIGN-003): the tool and its version, the source document and its digest, the slide, the export, the author and the time. Sent with a presentation to a DigitalSignalix Manager, and with each asset in the 'Provenance' header (base64url-encoded). Unknown properties are allowed for forward compatibility: a receiver ignores what it does not know.

tool.description: The program that made the file.

version.description: As shown in its About window, e.g. '0.3.0+20261104' (the date of the build as SemVer build metadata).

commit.description: The commit it was built from (short or full).

source.description: The document the file was made from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the document as saved, in lowercase hexadecimal.

origin.description: Where it was opened from, only for a network place (FILE-029): a repository, a WebDAV / Nextcloud folder.

slide.description: The slide the file shows, from 1 (for an asset).

author.description: The user's name, only when given in the settings and left checked when sending.

created.description: When the file was made, in UTC (RFC 3339).
